archive.title: Ebbets Field
archive.caption: Ebbets Field was a Major League Baseball stadium in the Flatbush section of Brooklyn, New York City. It is mainly known for having been the home of the Brooklyn Dodgers baseball team of the National League (1913–1957).

archive.title: 1916 World Series
archive.caption: The 1916 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball for the 1916 season.

archive.title: Jackie Robinson
archive.caption: Jack Roosevelt Robinson was an American professional baseball player who was the first African American to play in Major League Baseball (MLB) in the modern era.

archive.title: 1952 World Series
archive.caption: The 1952 World Series featured the three-time defending champion New York Yankees beating the Brooklyn Dodgers in seven games.

archive.title: 1953 World Series
archive.caption: The 1953 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball for the 1953 season.

archive.title: 1955 World Series
archive.caption: The 1955 World Series was the championship series of Major League Baseball's (MLB) 1955 season.

archive.title: 1963 World Series
archive.caption: The 1963 World Series was the championship series of Major League Baseball's (MLB) 1963 season.
